capabilities: Synchronize notes and small attachments through a private GitHub repository branch
Detect three-way changes from the last successful common commit
Preserve both versions of conflicting notes as conflict copies
Run syncs manually, at startup, in the foreground, or on an interval
Exclude .obsidian, .trash, .git, oversized files, and custom globs from sync
extras: README warns not to run it alongside Obsidian Sync, iCloud vault sync, Remotely Save, or Self-hosted LiveSync; automatic sync is off by default and sync only runs while Obsidian is open; default file-size cap is 25 MB; no payments, ads, analytics, or telemetry; tokens stored in Obsidian Secret Storage; privacy and security details are in separate PRIVACY.md and SECURITY.md files.
motivation: The README says it is designed for desktop and mobile Obsidian without Git CLI, Node file-system, or Electron dependencies.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a vault in sync across desktop and mobile devices using only a GitHub account and no Git tooling or other sync services.

relations.evidence: connects directly to api.github.com to read and update the configured repository

requires.name: GitHub account with a private repository and fine-grained personal access token

summary: Vault synchronization plugin that pushes notes and small attachments to a branch of a private GitHub repository without Git CLI.
